summary: Iteration 6 verified the 3 new features on both backend & mobile web (390x844). Backend (test_iteration6.py, 11/11 pass): (1) POST /api/offers/{id}/accept happy path (customer accepts an Admin-approved Freigegeben offer) creates order 'Neu' with fromOffer + copied items, sets offer.status='Angenommen' and offer.orderId to the new B-2026 id — verified via GET round-trip on both offers and orders. (2) 400 returned for accepting an offer still in 'Freigabe nötig' (message 'Nur freigegebene Angebote können angenommen werden.'). (3) 400 returned for a second accept of an already-converted offer (server hits the status-guard first because status has become 'Angenommen'; the orderId guard is defensive dead code — both 400 branches are compliant with the spec). (4) 403 returned when the customer tries to accept an approved offer belonging to a company outside their visible set (c3). (5) Seeded p1 exposes discountTiers [(50,16.20),(100,15.50)] and p2 exposes [(50,18.20),(100,17.50)] via /api/products. (6) POST/PUT /api/products persist and round-trip discountTiers including replace-and-clear. (7) POST /api/offers/{id}/approve still returns 200 and mutates status to 'Freigegeben' even though the email path is invoked (backend logs show 202 Accepted from the Emergent email integration for most attempts; some 422 / 429 responses are caught by try/except and logged as WARN — endpoint still 200, non-blocking works). (8) PUT /api/orders/{id}/status with 'Versendet' returns 200 and attaches trackingNumber (SS<yymmdd><suffix>), shippedAt, estimatedDelivery (T+2 days). (9) Regression: role hiding of 'cost' still holds for sales AND customer on /api/products. Frontend (390x844): ADMIN /angebote → approve-A-2026-0187 clickable, DB line 'DB: … /Monat · Vertrag ca. …' visible on the pending card, status flips to 'Freigegeben' after tap. SALES /angebote → create-offer-card visible; picking c1+p1 and qty=60 renders tier-box with both tiers highlighted (✓ on 50-kg tier) and apply-tier fills offer-price-input to 16.2; NO 'DB:' / '/Monat' text anywhere on the screen. CUSTOMER /angebote → for the approved offer, accept-offer-A-2026-0187 button 'Angebot annehmen & bestellen' is visible, no DB info leaked; tapping it navigates to /bestellung/B-2026-01002; back on /angebote the card now shows 'Angenommen' status + view-order-A-2026-0187 button 'Zur Bestellung B-2026-01002'. CUSTOMER /bestellungen reorder-card: default main product is p2 (Caffè Aiello Strong, customer price 17,90 €/kg). tier-active does NOT appear at 50 kg — correct behavior because p2's first tier (18,20) is >= customer's negotiated price (17,90) and bestellungen.tsx only activates a tier when tier.price < basePrice (guards against a tier being applied as a price increase). At 100 kg, tier-active shows 'Mengenrabatt aktiv · ab 100 kg statt 17,90 €' (second tier 17,50 IS cheaper). ADMIN /produkte edit p1: tier-qty-0=50, tier-price-0=16.2, tier-qty-1=100, tier-price-1=15.5, add-tier and tier-remove-0 present. Demo state restored: A-2026-0187 back to 'Freigabe nötig' (orderId unset), A-2026-0181 stays 'Freigegeben', all fromOffer / >=B-2026-01001 orders deleted, no TEST_ products, counters reset (order=1000, offer=200, product=4).

react_native_issues.issue: Carry-over from iter 3–5: react-native-web deprecation warning 'shadow*' style props — should migrate to 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx.
Carry-over warnings 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and 'TouchableMixin is deprecated' from vendored charts library. Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/auswertungen.tsx.

action_items: None required for the 3 tested features — all pass end-to-end.

Optional cleanup (not iter6-specific): in server.py accept_offer the second 400 guard 'Angebot wurde bereits umgewandelt' is unreachable in practice because acceptance also flips status away from 'Freigegeben', so the first guard fires. If the more informative message is important, either swap the order of the two checks OR combine them: `if o['status'] != 'Freigegeben' or o.get('orderId'): raise 400('…')` with a message covering both.

Optional: the Resend integration returned 422/429 on some calls in server logs (WARN E-Mail (…) fehlgeschlagen). This is caught and does not affect the API contract, but consider validating the company email address at approve-time before calling the integration to reduce 422 noise, and add exponential backoff for 429 during heavy testing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:644-670 accept_offer: correct order of checks — visible_company_ids first (403), then status (400), then orderId (400). Items copied verbatim so tier price selected by the customer is preserved. Good.
server.py:735-740: trackingNumber only set if not present ('and not o.get(...)') — idempotent when Versendet is re-applied. estimatedDelivery = now + 2 days.
server.py:622-640 & 742-765: both email blocks are wrapped in try/except and log at WARN — endpoint returns 200 regardless. Correct.
server.py:296-299 DiscountTier model uses float for both minQty and price — matches the seed and FE contract.

frontend/app/(tabs)/bestellungen.tsx:40-41: `unitPrice = tier && tier.price < basePrice ? tier.price : basePrice` — correctly guards against a tier increasing the price when the customer already has a better negotiated price. Verified live with p2 at 50 kg (no activation) vs 100 kg (activation).
frontend/app/(tabs)/angebote.tsx:113-122: accept-offer button gated on !isStaff && status==='Freigegeben'; view-order gated on !isStaff && status==='Angenommen' && orderId. Correct role isolation.

frontend/app/(tabs)/angebote.tsx:81-84: monthlyDb calc uses `p.cost` which is undefined for sales role — the surrounding <View> is gated on `isAdmin && status==='Freigabe nötig'`, so no NaN leak, but keeping the calc inside the isAdmin branch would be tidier.
frontend/src/lib/pricing.ts:4-12 applicableTier returns the highest tier whose minQty is met — correct semantics, unit-friendly. No off-by-one.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows: admin approve+DB line, sales tier-box+apply-tier+no DB, customer accept→order create+navigate→Angenommen+view-order, produkte tier CRUD form, bestellungen tier-active behavior).

Cleanup lives inside test_iteration6::TestCleanupRestore and was also run manually after the two Playwright sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 6 shipped 3 new features: (a) POST /api/offers/{id}/accept — customer converts approved offer to order; sets order.fromOffer, offer.status='Angenommen', offer.orderId. Guards: 403 cross-company, 400 not 'Freigegeben', 400 already converted (dead branch in practice — see action items). (b) Product.discountTiers: [{minQty,price}] persisted through POST/PUT /api/products. Seeded p1: [(50,16.20),(100,15.50)]; p2: [(50,18.20),(100,17.50)]. Frontend components: angebote CreateOffer shows testID='tier-box' + 'apply-tier' when a product with tiers is selected and qty>=lowest tier; bestellungen shows testID='tier-active' when applicableTier(...).price < customerPrice. produkte form testIDs: add-tier, tier-qty-{i}, tier-price-{i}, tier-remove-{i}. (c) Emergent Email (Resend) — POST /api/offers/{id}/approve and PUT /api/orders/{id}/status status='Versendet' each try/except a send_email call; endpoint contract unaffected on send failure. Backend logs show 202 Accepted for successful sends and WARN E-Mail (…) fehlgeschlagen for 422/429 responses — non-blocking is verified. Playwright note: navigate to Expo Router routes via `page.goto(BASE + '/angebote')` etc. — clicking bottom tab labels does not always work in web preview. Always use testID selectors; the login screen uses login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button. Cleanup helper if leftover orders occur: python3 -c 'from pymongo import MongoClient; db=MongoClient("mongodb://localhost:27017")["ss_b2b_database"]; db.orders.delete_many({"$or":[{"fromOffer":{"$exists":True}},{"id":{"$gte":"B-2026-01001"}}]}); db.counters.update_one({"_id":"order"},{"$set":{"seq":1000}}, upsert=True); db.offers.update_one({"id":"A-2026-0187"},{"$set":{"status":"Freigabe nötig"},"$unset":{"orderId":""}})'.
rca_of_issue: No unresolved bugs. Two minor observations captured under action_items: (1) The second 400 guard for 'already converted' in accept_offer is unreachable because the status check fires first — cosmetic, both branches satisfy the spec. (2) Some email integration calls returned 422/429 during heavy re-testing; try/except correctly swallows them, endpoints still 200 — no user impact.
